narration: Your boss just gave you a 3% raise and expected gratitude. Here's the thing — that barely keeps up with inflation. The stranger they just hired? Started at 18% more than you for the same job.
visual: Person at a desk with a monitor showing '+3%', red badge labeled 'LOYAL EMPLOYEE', green badge 'NEW HIRE +18%' sliding in from right

narration: Companies literally run two salary budgets — one small one to keep you, and a bigger one to recruit outsiders. The loyalty budget is capped. The external budget isn't.
visual: Two growing bar charts side by side — short red bar labeled 'KEEP YOU 3%' vs tall green bar labeled 'HIRE OUTSIDER 18-20%'

narration: People who switch jobs every two to three years earn 10 to 20 percent more each move. Run that math over a decade and the total earnings gap hits a hundred and forty-seven thousand dollars.
visual: Two horizontal salary bars racing — red bar for loyal employee growing slowly to $80K, green bar for job-hopper surging to $227K, gap counter badge showing $147,000

narration: Your brain treats familiarity as safety — that's called status quo bias. Companies count on that instinct to keep your salary frozen while their profits grow without you.
visual: Brain SVG with a chain and anchor labeled 'STATUS QUO BIAS' pulling it down, green dollar signs floating upward above the brain out of reach

narration: The person being hired right now to do your job is starting higher than your current salary. Next year they'll get the same 3% you always get — and the gap never closes.
visual: Two person figures side by side — left person sitting at desk labeled 'YOU $65K', right person walking in labeled 'NEW HIRE $79K', green gap arrow between them

narration: That next job offer isn't a betrayal — it's math. Your career is a business. Businesses negotiate. Follow for more money truths nobody in the office will tell you.
visual: Person silhouette walking through an open door into bright green light, 'YOUR CAREER IS A BUSINESS' text overlay, 'NEGOTIATE ACCORDINGLY' badge
